user.title: What would you like to track?
user.description: A monitor observes one activity rule and creates its own Home Assistant device.

data.template: How would you like to begin?

source.title: Choose the activity source
source.description: Name the monitor. Zone presence also needs the tracked person or device and the zone.

data_description.name: A clear name for this monitor device and its entities.
data_description.entity_id: The person or device tracker whose state is observed.
data_description.zone_entity_id: Only this zone counts as activity.

template_rule.title: Define template rule
template_rule.description: Both templates must render a Home Assistant boolean. Current preview — start: {start_result}; stop: {stop_result}.

behavior.title: Choose session behavior
behavior.description: These choices apply to this monitor's completed sessions and presentation.

data_description.duration_unit: Accounting remains exact seconds; this selects the sensor display unit.
data_description.retention_days: Number of local calendar days to retain.
data_description.minimum_session_seconds: Use 0 to keep every completed session.
data_description.cross_midnight_policy: Started day assigns all duration to the date it starts. Ended day assigns all duration to the date it ends. Split at local midnight assigns each real fragment and one session to every participating date.

periods.title: Choose report periods
periods.description: Current periods are observed to date. Last 1 is yesterday and Last 2 is the day before yesterday.

period_metrics.title: Choose report sensors
period_metrics.description: Select at least one report sensor for {period}.

metrics.title: Choose monitor-wide sensors
metrics.description: These optional sensors do not have a report period.

review.title: Review this monitor

error.required: Provide at least one value before continuing.
error.invalid_previous_days: Use positive whole numbers separated by commas, for example: 1, 2, 7.
error.condition_required: Choose a saved condition to remove.
error.conditions_required: Keep or add at least one condition before continuing.
error.invalid_template: Enter a valid Home Assistant template.

init.description: Edit the template, source, conditions, reports, sensors, or behavior.
